planning_rule: Serialized packet UTF-8 bytes plus declared maximum output tokens and scaffolding reserve must not exceed the explicitly declared context window. The minimum unit-coverage reply must also fit the declared output allowance. Bytes are conservative planning units, not a measured token count or a guarantee of account/CLI capacity; a valid complete verdict may require more output than its minimum echo.
coverage_rule: Every source unit must have a valid continuing independent part verdict or an exact unchanged-case certificate from a verified continuing prior checkpoint. Any negative verdict stops; partial coverage cannot continue.
partition_rule: Keep each complete case with its final outcome and associated review requests/responses. Other report/audit data is partitioned as complete rows or values. No sampling, truncation, automatic context upgrade or implicit additional calls.
